pred_texts: Instruct: Grab two slices of bread and put them in the toaster. Toast for around a minute.
Instruct: Now get the pizza sauce and spread two tablespoons on each slice of bread.
Instruct: Now spread it evenly on the bread.
Instruct: Now cover each slice of bread with shredded mozzarella cheese.
Instruct: Add some oregano on top of the cheese toast according to your taste.
Instruct: Now add at least 3 to 4 olives to the top of the cheese toasts.
Instruct: Now microwave the cheese toast in a microwave-safe utensil for around 45 to 60 seconds.
